sloka: कृता शास्त्र अनुगा बुद्धिर् मा भूत् तस्य कदाचन ।सत्य सम्धः सताम् श्रेष्ठो यस्य आर्यो अनुमते गतः ॥२-७५-२१॥
transliteration: kṛtā śāstra anugā buddhir mā bhūt tasya kadācana ।satya samdhaḥ satām śreṣṭho yasya āryo anumate gataḥ ॥2-75-21॥

translations.english: Did not the one who counselled the banishment of my noble brother who is steadfast and bound by truth and virtue, ever adhered to scriptures? (or) My noble brother (Rama), the best among the virtuous, bound to truth, is banished. Let not such thought occur at any time to one who steadfastly adheres to scriptures
translations.hindi: अरे नृशंसे ! तेरी दृष्टि राजवम की ओर नहीं है और न तू राजधम के विविध सनातन प्रकारों ही को जानती है
